name: Amazon.com, Inc.
monetization: Sells AI compute through AWS (Nvidia GPUs + Trainium custom silicon) against a ~$496B backlog; holds large equity stakes in both Anthropic and OpenAI; spending ~$220B of capex in 2026.
description_md: Amazon spans e-commerce, advertising, logistics, and AWS — the largest cloud-infrastructure business, and the balance-sheet anchor of the AI buildout on the demand side. AWS grew 37% y/y in Q2 2026 (its fastest in 18 quarters) to $42.2B, with contracted commitments (backlog) jumping to ~$496B. Amazon is Anthropic's largest outside shareholder (convertible instruments carried near $98B after a ~$53.4B Q2-26 fair-value gain) and completed a $50B investment in OpenAI, making it the only company with major equity in both leading labs while also selling both of them compute.
ai_monetization_md: (1) **AWS compute** — AI business crossed a $25B annualized run rate in Q2-26, growing triple digits; custom silicon (Trainium/Inferentia) independently crossed $25B annualized. Anthropic's >$100B decade-scale commitment (including up to 5GW of Trainium via Project Rainier) and OpenAI's $38B/7yr + $100B/8yr expansion contracts anchor the ~$496B backlog. (2) **Investment gains** — the Anthropic stake produced a $53.4B pre-tax, non-operating fair-value gain in Q2-26 alone (net income $62.6B, of which operating income was only $27.5B); the OpenAI position ($15B funded at the Mar 2026 close, $35B milestone tranche completed per press, ~5% stake) was carried at $28.7B in the Q2-26 10-Q. (3) **Consumer/ads AI** — Alexa+, Rufus, and ad-tech AI monetize across the retail franchise.
ai_strategy_md: Outspend and vertically integrate: ~$220B of 2026 cash capex (raised from ~$200B, partly on memory costs), with management saying capacity will still not meet demand through 2027. Dual-track silicon strategy — deep Nvidia partnership plus Trainium, whose biggest proof point is Anthropic's 5GW Project Rainier commitment. Dual-lab equity strategy — $8B+$5B into Anthropic and $50B into OpenAI — converts lab upside into balance-sheet gains while both labs are also AWS customers (equity_for_revenue pattern on both edges). Nuclear PPAs (Talen $18B/17yr Susquehanna, Vistra Comanche Peak) lock in power.
risk_notes_md: **Earnings quality:** Q2-26 net income of $62.6B included a $53.4B non-cash, non-recurring Anthropic mark — headline profit overstates run-rate earnings by ~5x for the quarter; marks reverse in a downcycle exactly when AWS AI revenue would slow (correlation risk, the IMF's amplification point). **Circularity:** Amazon funds Anthropic and OpenAI with equity while recognizing their spend as AWS revenue and backlog; the ~$496B backlog's largest components are labs whose losses are funded by their suppliers' investments. **Capex/FCF pressure:** ~$220B of 2026 capex compresses free cash flow. **Useful-life precedent:** Amazon's own 6→5-year server-life change cost $677M over 9 months — the calibration point for the sector-wide depreciation debate.
